pairs.evidence: src/lib/catalog/acceptance/judgeBridge.ts:8 This context works out acceptance tiers and merges judge verdicts, and it has no speech capture or synthesis. A case-insensitive search of src/components/layout-lab and src/lib/catalog/acceptance found no getUserMedia, speechSynthesis, SpeechRecognition, transcri or microphone. The only 'voice' and 'speech' hits (contractsCheckers.ts:79, invariants.ts:141) are game-content rules about dialogue VO lines, not the product listening or speaking.
